meta.name: evaluate
meta.description: Evaluate an AI workflow against representative cases and its permitted actions. Use for model, retrieval or agent evaluation; tests do not grant release authority.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代表性案例检验 AI 工作流,提前看清模型、检索与智能体到底靠不靠谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿不准 AI 模型或智能体上线后的实际效果
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're unsure how well your AI model or agent actually performs

howto.what: Claude 会按任务上下文契约与方法，用代表性案例和被允许的操作来评估 AI 工作流（模型、检索、agent 等），并如实报告缺失的能力或未运行的检查；测试本身不授予发布权限。
howto.when: 当你需要评估模型、检索或 agent 工作流时触发；若由 @fde 调用，会复用其当前已清洗的数据包与范围，不重启设置或重问已答过的问题。

say.text: 用代表性案例评估这个 AI 工作流，并列出被允许的操作
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约与方法，再开始评估

say.text: 帮我评估这个检索流程，缺什么能力就如实说
say.note: 缺失能力或未运行的检查会如实报告

say.text: 评估这个 agent 工作流，区分实现、验证、部署与验收
say.note: 会保留未知项，区分实现、验证、部署、验收

howto.what_en: Claude evaluates an AI workflow against representative cases and its permitted actions, covering model, retrieval or agent evaluation, and honestly reports missing capabilities or unrun checks. Tests do not grant release authority.
howto.when_en: Use when you need a model, retrieval or agent workflow evaluated. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or re-asking answered questions.

say_en.text: Evaluate this AI workflow on representative cases and its permitted actions
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and method first

say_en.text: Evaluate this retrieval pipeline; report honestly if a capability is missing
say_en.note: Missing capabilities or unrun checks are reported honestly

say_en.text: Evaluate this agent workflow; separate implementation, verification, deployment
say_en.note: Preserves unknowns; keeps the four stages distinct
